text:
Until that the oscuridad creadora of the humanidad

Procreadora of pájaro animal and flor

And of all the cosas humillante

Say in silence the last estallido of the light

And the hora quieta

Venga of the mares brincando in his montura


And between I of new in the redonda

Sion of the cuenta of water

And the sinagoga of the espiga

Not diré siquiera shadow of prayer

Or sembraré my simiente of sal

In the more mínimo valle of the cilicio for lamentar


The majestad and the fire of esta death infantil

Not I will kill

His humanidad diciendo truth grave

Ni profanaré the estaciones of the aliento

With another

Elegía a the inocencia and youth.


In it deep with the primer dead yace the hija of Londres,

Of viejos amigos arropada,

The grano already crecido, the negras venas of his mother,

Oculta for the aguas impasibles

Of the jineteante Támesis.

Not existe more that a death primera.

translation.title: Until that the oscuridad creadora of the humanidad...
